title_en: At the Urban Gate Complex, 2+1+Verandah Apartment For Sale With Perfect Orientation!!!
description_en: At the Urban Gate Complex, 2+1+Verandah Apartment for Sale with Perfect Orientation and Regular Cubes. The apartment has a total area of ​​153 m2, of which 88.7 m2 net, 47.3 m2 veranda and 16.9 m2 common area. The apartment is located on the 8th floor and is organized into a living room with a kitchenette, a double bedroom, a children's room, both with access to the veranda, and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-East, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The Urban Gate complex is a residential building of 6-10 floors with 2 floors of underground parking and stands out for the high-quality works starting from the hydraulic-electrical installations, ventilated facades, paving with tiles or parquet according to the customer's wishes, thermal double-glazed windows equipped with shutters, rest spaces and green spaces around the complex which will be carried out by the "Urban Planning & Development shpk" company.
